bull_bear.body:
- Raised Rs. 23.17 Crores through financing activities in FY26 (Rs. 6.79 Crores equity, Rs. 13.68 Crores other equity instruments, Rs. 2.70 Crores borrowings), fully deployed into the loan book, investments, and technology infrastructure.
- Debt-to-Equity ratio of 0.10x (total equity Rs. 29.34 Crores vs. borrowings of Rs. 3.01 Crores) provides 'substantial headroom to scale the loan book as warrant capital is progressively deployed.'
- Paid-up equity capital expanded from Rs. 5.12 Crores to Rs. 8.12 Crores during the year through preferential allotments; book value per share stands at Rs. 3.61.

business.body:
- RBI-registered NBFC (Reg. No. 01.00109), incorporated 1993, renamed from Ramchandra Leasing & Finance Limited to Raama Finance Limited; engaged in leasing, hire purchase, secured and unsecured lending, and digital lending through its FastSalary platform.
- FastSalary (www.fastsalary.com) built a 'meaningful customer franchise from a standing start' in its first year, entering FY27 with 'strong momentum, a live technology infrastructure, and a validated product-market fit.'
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

deepdive.thesis: Raama Finance positions itself as a legacy RBI-registered NBFC (formerly Ramchandra Leasing & Finance) reborn around its digital lending platform FastSalary, which delivered a validated product-market fit and a historic, profitable FY26 in its first year of scaled operation.
